title: Universal Language Model Fine-tuning for Text Classification
before: Pretraining helped, but fine-tuning often destroyed what pretraining had learned.
problem: Naive fine-tuning causes catastrophic forgetting of general knowledge.
breakthrough: A fine-tuning recipe: gradual unfreezing, discriminative learning rates per layer, and a shaped schedule.
why: It made transfer learning reliable for text and put the pretrain-fine-tune loop in mainstream practice.
next: GPT-1 and BERT arrived within the year and absorbed the practice.
inherits: The fine-tuning craft that LoRA and QLoRA later made cheap.
